visual_review.notes: H3 video. The first idle plates flip on a quarter of the frames and the vine swings wide, so the idle was retaken from one reference with the loops hanging close; it skips the rejected plates. The first attack whip ran off the top and both sides, so it was retaken with 128 px of room on three sides; even so the whip runs past the frame at full extension, so the attack skips those frames, the overhead frames that clip the top and the return swing that clips the bottom and left, and the lash onto the ground at screen right stands as the contact. The defend skips the smeared frames as the vine wraps the arms, the cast skips the ghosted vine as the arm rises and lowers, and the death skips the two smeared frames as she falls onto her side. The walk loops on frames 34 to 94.
